message:
feat(desktop): UI-010 design tokens, themes, and component state gallery (#45)

Establish the production design-system foundation (issue #22):

- tokens.css: complete --hs-* semantic layer (surfaces incl. score paper,
  text, borders, accent, focus, status, waveform, score-selection states),
  JP font stack (Yu Gothic UI/Meiryo), 6-step type scale, 4px spacing grid,
  functional radii, reserved elevation, motion durations + reduced-motion.
- fluentTheme.ts: bind the JP font stack into Fluent light/dark themes.
- primitives/: 15 Fluent v9 wrappers (Button, IconButton, SegmentedControl,
  Tooltip, Popover, Menu, Slider, NumericField, Select, Progress,
  StatusBadge/ReviewBadge, Panel, Dialog, Sheet) with Japanese labels and
  accessible names; SpinButton increment/decrement get JP aria-labels.
- dev gallery at #/dev/gallery (import.meta.env.DEV gated, lazy-loaded,
  excluded from prod bundle): every primitive across
  default/hover/pressed/focus/selected/disabled/loading/error in both
  light and dark themes plus representative screen-state fixtures
  (empty, transcribing, review, export, error).
- Migrate PitchSegmented, ScoreWorkspace, SettingsView onto primitives.
- All new user-facing copy lives in strings/ja.ts per the UI-006 deck.

Refs #22

Generated with [Devin](https://devin.ai)
